title: How Deep Does St Peter's Basilica Go?
description:
How deep does St Peter's Basilica go?
Below the floor of the Vatican's great church lie the popes' crypt, a buried Roman street of family tombs, and the niche the Church holds to be St Peter's grave.
Sources: Wikipedia, Vatican Necropolis; Turismo Roma; Barcelo travel guide (2025).
Depths from published sources. Cutaway illustrations, not to scale.
